reasons: Claimed status is compliant and the cited § 14.16 (Freedom of Action) affirmatively confirms each party may enter similar agreements with others, directly supporting that no exclusivity or sole-supplier obligation binds the Customer.

Rationale correctly distinguishes the unrelated 'exclusive warranties' / 'nonexclusive license' usages from purchasing exclusivity, and notes order-form-based charges with no requirements or volume commitment.
No redline or comment was proposed, which is the expected output for a compliant finding; the deterministic check confirming no residual sole-supplier obligation is consistent.
Meets the preferred position (no exclusivity on Customer), so retaining this as internal evidence rather than a negotiation issue is appropriate.
